# Results for the frozen judge (generated by analysis/final.py)

Frozen judge: c3, fingerprint `1b1bebcddff9f66c`, threshold 0.5. Runs: dev `gh38104945965-c3-labeled-dev`, test `gh38115612251-c3-labeled-test`, v4 `gh38116159452-c3-v4-prod`.

## Dev and test

| Split | Items | TP | FN | FP | TN | TPR | TNR | TPR + TNR - 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dev | 158 | 83 | 4 | 2 | 69 | 0.954 | 0.972 | 0.926 |
